description: Scans a website and returns its AI Visibility Score (0-100): whether AI crawlers and agents can find, read and cite it. Eight weighted signals (content readable without JavaScript, AI crawler access in robots.txt, structured data, semantic structure, metadata, performance, llms.txt, sitemap), each with a concrete fix when it fails. Free, no account.

url.description: Domain or URL of the site, e.g. "example.com" or "https://example.com". Use your own site or one you are authorized to review.

name: scan_website
title: Scan AI readability
